The structure of Mg12Ti2Zn2 (reduced formula Mg6TiZn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: each Mg, Ti, and Zn atom has 12 geometric neighbors, with Mg environments ranging from 10 Mg and 2 Zn to 2 Mg and 10 Ti neighbors, while Ti and Zn centers coordinate to 10 Mg and 2 Zn or Ti, respectively. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts show Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces.
